Uniformity trial of 24 x 16 basic units (simulated)

Source: R/pathology.R
uniformity_trial.Rd

Simulated yields (kg) of a uniformity trial harvested in 384 basic units (24 rows by 16 columns), with a fertility gradient along the rows and patchy variation; suited to Smith's index of soil heterogeneity.

Usage

uniformity_trial

Format

A numeric matrix with 24 rows (R1...R24) and 16 columns (C1...C16).

Examples

smith_index(uniformity_trial)
